mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate above 13.5% triggers a labor market tightening, reducing corporate profit expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not cross the 13.5% threshold in the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 250 signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not occur as predicted, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) above 19,000 suggests robust economic activity, lifting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not exceed 19,000 in the next quarter, or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (RSAFS) signal robust demand, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 50 AND RSAFS rises > 1000 in the next month
failure_condition: The combined demand indicators do not rise as expected, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tighter policy, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not rise above 4.5% in the tightening regime, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 133,000 indicates labor market strength, raising wage growth expectations and corporate costs, which may suppress S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 88 in the next month
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not exceed 133,000 in the next month, or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-tests).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 92.6 suggests improved supply chain dynamics, reducing bottlenecks and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise above 92.6 in the next 2 months, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05 in t-tests).
